questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff covers all three parts of R-ORDER-NOTE. PlaceOrder now takes an optional note through a variadic parameter. Before it validates the session, reserves stock or charges the customer, it counts the note's runes and returns ErrNoteTooLong if there are more than 200, so a longer note is rejected and no order is placed. It also saves the note in the new Order.Note field, so the order keeps its note. The tests cover an empty note, a plain note and a note of exactly 200 characters, and check that each one ends up on the order. They also check that a 201-character note returns ErrNoteTooLong, with stock left unchanged and no audit entries, which shows the order was not placed.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-62. Checkout accepts an optional order note, saves it on the returned order, and rejects notes over 200 Unicode characters before reserving stock or charging the customer. Existing `PlaceOrder` calls still work.

Added boundary and rejection tests and updated [REQUIREMENTS.md](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T5.3/repo/REQUIREMENTS.md). `go test ./...` passes.
